directly_defined: Skew is a statistical projection condition, not a direct RT_core output.
Omega_a is the provisional classifier for balanced, exclusion-dominant, and addition-dominant cases.
Skew sign requires declared orientation/sign convention and iff_s metadata.
inferred_inside_framework: Omega_a > 1 classifies exclusion dominance under declared convention.
Omega_a < 1 classifies addition dominance under declared convention.
external_resemblance: Positive or negative skew language is representational only and depends on the declared observation axis.
does_not_prove: No universal distribution law is established.
No empirical distribution claim is made.
failure_modes: Missing orientation convention makes skew sign undefined.
Missing F_s makes projected distribution shape undefined.
Mixed regimes without equivalence rules invalidate aggregation.
Observed skew does not by itself prove primary dominance.
